projects.title: Conditional Notification & Routing Automation
projects.summary: An event-driven flow that filters new records and routes each notification to the right reviewer, with a fallback so nothing gets dropped. It includes a live router you can operate yourself.

projects.title: Interactive ArcGIS Map Popups

projects.title: Network Center of Gravity Tool
projects.summary: A custom geoprocessing tool that finds the best central location for a workforce. I cut the runtime from over an hour to a few minutes by finding and removing a defect that generated 53 million candidate locations.

home.support: Clarity from complexity. I take the geographic, operational, and market data you already have and connect it into something you can actually use to make decisions.

home.workTitle: Four projects that show how I work.
home.aboutTitle: I help organizations get more from the systems they already have.
home.aboutBody: I build the bridges between the systems organizations already own. Most teams already have the data they need. The problem is that it lives in systems that were never built to talk to each other, and my job is to fix that. Almost everything a business tracks has a geographic component, whether that's a location, a region, or a route. I build upon those connections to help businesses better understand the wealth of information they have access to and help them make better sense of it all. That means less time trying to figure out what all the data means, and more time understanding the business value that it can hold.
home.ctaTitle: Have systems that don’t talk to each other?
home.ctaBody: This is the kind of problem I like best. Tell me where the manual handoffs and disconnected datasets are, and I'll show you what one connected system can do for your team.
